blocks.html: RLC GROUND BREAKS ITS FIRST RESIDENTIAL CONDOMINIUM BUILDING IN GREENHILLS SAN JUAN DISTRICT

Robinsons Communities marked yet another significant phase for its top-notch projects in the Greenhills, San Juan area, as it held the Groundbreaking Ceremony for Chimes Greenhills. Attended by Robinsons Land Corporation’s (RLC) President Mr. Frederick D. Go, and San Juan Mayor Guia G. Gomez, the Chimes Greenhills Groundbreaking Ceremony signifies an important phase in the construction of the project as it strengthens Robinsons Communities' commitment to deliver quality and affordable condominium projects.

Upon its completion, Chimes Greenhills, located along Annapolis Street, Greenhills, will be a 40 storey residential tower with a hotel component. Units are well-laid out with residents enjoying the amenities which include Private Theater and Sky Garden. Chimes Greenhills also offers convenience due to its proximity to schools, hospitals, shopping centers. Key business districts and lifestyle hubs are a mere 30-minute drive. Interested buyers can inquire on Chimes Greenhills, available in friendly payment terms, which gives you access to an affordable alternative to living in a prominent Metro Manila address.
To know more about Chimes Greenhills, you may visit Robinsons Communities official website www.robinsonscommunities.comor call 248-5888 and text 0932-700-0000.
